PEO Pricing Models

The PEO service has various prices for each business need so, explore the PEO pricing factors. Likewise, the main types of prices are:

  • Per Check or Employee or Unbundled
  • Burden Rat or Bundled Pricing.

Per Check, Per Employee, or Period type (Unbundled) PEO Price Model

This type of PEO pricing model is the most common because it offers flexibility in paying. Likewise, payment will depend on the number of checks or workers at a specific time.

How does it work?

With the per-check model, industries will pay the fee for the number of payroll checks issued by a PEO. Equally, the amount will be fixed for checks. Similarly, another advantage will be that the company pays only for the services that they use. Therefore, it is a good option for businesses with jobs with varying levels.

On the other hand, the type of cost per employee for a PEO uses charging per worker rates for duck time. Also, with its structure, the company will be able to have a consistent budget for the human resources service. Additionally, you will have the opportunity to choose the payroll percentage for the specific model, with which the service will be based on the issued payroll.

Likewise, it is suitable for companies with variable and part-time staff such as stores and restaurants. Furthermore, in these businesses, the salary percentage is less and lower than that of regular companies.

Advantages of the Specialized Pricing Model

The cost per employee for a PEO in this model will give you the following additional advantages:

  • Predictable budget. In the Per Employee/Period type, companies will be able to calculate the cost of payroll and Human Resources in advance since they will be fixed.
  • With this model, you will obtain transparent processes because you will easily see the cost of checks, per worker, or period. This will allow you to clearly understand your expenses.
  • Comparison between Cost and effectiveness: disaggregated prices will guarantee that the company pays for human resources. Moreover, due to the payroll services they provide, you will save compared to the usual model.

Additional considerations

The cost per employee for a PEO per Check or Per Employee/Period (Unbundled) will provide many benefits to your company. However, please note the following considerations:

  • The size of the company. Depending on the number of employees concerning the checks issued, it is necessary to evaluate to see what is most consistent with all of this.
  • Unstable workforce. If your company experiences many changes in the workforce, the Per Check type of PEO is the best option. Thus, you will gain greater flexibility when managing costs.
  • Stability in record time. For companies with a stable workforce, you can use the Per Employee/ model that will give you fixed prices and budgets

The Unbundled Pricing Model

This model is profitable and flexible and will adapt HR and payroll expenses based on your particular needs. Additionally, you will choose better, by understanding the advantages and the elements that you can take into account when choosing one of the 2 structures. Likewise, you will find the one that fits your budget and your business requirements.

The cost per employee for a PEO is based on the cost per balance sheet. That is, the company will pay a fixed rate for each worker it has and who pays the cost of PEO services. In the same way, it benefits the company that requires permanent or variable personnel, because they will determine the HR services that they will actually use. It will also allow the service to scale, either increasing or decreasing as appropriate, which makes it profitable.

The load rate or bundled pricing model for PEO pricing

This Freight Rate or Bundled Pricing model is common in cost Per Employee for a PEO. Hence, it strengthens the different human resources services in a single or combined charging rate. Likewise, with this structure, you will obtain a comprehensive HR solution and facilitate billing.

How does it act?

When you compare costs, you will notice that this model of service will charge a stable percentage of the total payroll. Additionally, this charge rate will include payroll tax rates, compensatory insurance, benefits direction, and compliance direction. In comparison, companies will only pay the combined cost including human resources services.

This makes it predictable and consequently facilitates the billing process and therefore the task of Human Resources.

Advantages Provided By The Grouped Pricing Model

This rate management model will offer the following benefits for your company:

  • Simplified Billing. This model makes payments easier because it reduces the hassle that this causes because all human resources services are grouped in one invoice.
  • Complete Solution. The model will give you access to all human resources services, including payroll taxes, employee compensation, and retirement plans, among others. Likewise, you can rest assured that you will have all the HR requirements in full.
  • Predictable Costs. With a standard percentage, the charge rate becomes predictable which means you can better plan HR expenses. Thus, you will not have fluctuating or unexpected fees in the payroll burden.
  • Savings In Resources And Time. Bundled pricing will save both time and resources. Otherwise, you would incur unnecessary expenses in managing providers or comparing rates for particular services. Consequently, it will allow you and your human resources department to concentrate on the basic productive activities of the company.

How to calculate your PEO cost per employee

The cost per employee for a PEO involves several expenses that are related to the worker as you will see below:

  • Training and development platforms
  • EAPs or employee assistance programs
  • State unemployment insurance scheme uae
  • PEOs may also offer disability coverage
  • Life insurance

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance

Additionally, you can compare the benefits given by an existing or alternative PEO service and thus compare the profitability.

Factors that influence the price of PEO services

Below, you will see in detail each factor that will influence the cost per employee for a PEO:

  • The number of workers. Your employee size will affect the cost of PEO services. That is, the more employees you have in your company, the higher the cost you will pay.
  • The companies. Not all companies have the same need for Human Resources. In reality, the cost to pay will depend on how complicated the need is.
  • Packages Included. PEO services offer various packages and of course, this will affect costs. Also, a package with complete or additional services will generate more costs.
  • Sometimes, in some companies, personalized human resources services will be needed. Hence, PEO services can offer these particular services but may incur an additional cost. Moreover, it will generally be used by applying it to processes larger than the basics.
  • Geographic location. In this case, the cost may vary about where your company operates the cost of living in the region and the labor laws of that region will also influence it.

In conclusion, the cost per employee for a PEO will depend on several factors that you should consider before hiring them. However, it is worth hiring these services because they will be able to adapt to your particular needs.

In the same way, they will offer you the peace of mind that comes from knowing that your company will have good HR administration.
